description.zh:
The description of the data source.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The default value is null.
description.en:
The description of the data source.   

It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The default value is null.

description.zh:
database gateway，数据库网关实例 ID。 >
如 Type 为 DG，则该字段必填。
description.en:
The ID of the database gateway instance. >
If Type is set to DG, this parameter is required.

description.zh:
数据源云实例 ID。 >
如 Type 为 RDS、PolarDB、DG，则该字段必填。
description.en:
The ID of the ECS instance of the data source. >
If Type is set to RDS, PolarDB, or DG, this parameter is required.

description.zh:
数据源 IP 地址。 >
如 Type 为 INTERNET、VPC，则该字段必填。
description.en:
The IP address of the data source. >
If Type is set to INTERNET or VPC, this parameter is required.

description.zh:
数据源名称。 长度为 2~128 个英文或中文字符，可包含数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。 >
不可包含 “/” 等非法字符
description.en:
The name of the data source. It must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). >
Invalid characters, such as slashes (/), are not allowed.

description.zh:
数据库连接密码（需经过 Base64 编码后传入）。  
例如，密码 abcd123@! 经过 Base64 转换后的值为 YWJjZDEyM0Ah。
description.en:
The password of the username that is used to access the database. It must be Base64 encoded.   
For example, for the password abcd123@!, the Base64-encoded value is YWJjZDEyM0Ah.

description.zh:
数据源端口。 >
如 Type 为 INTERNET、VPC，则该字段必填。
description.en:
The port number of the data source. >
If Type is set to INTERNET or VPC, this parameter is required.

description.zh:
数据库名。 >
如填写，后续迁移或同步操作，只会针对该数据库操作。
description.en:
The name of the database. >
If you specify this parameter, subsequent migration or synchronization operations will take effect on this database only.

description.zh:
MySQL 类型。  
包括 INTERNET、VPC、RDS、PolarDB 和 DG。
description.en:
The type of the MySQL data source.   
Valid values: INTERNET, VPC, RDS, PolarDB, and DG.
The username that is used to access the database.

description.zh:
数据源所属 VPC ID。 >
如 Type 为 VPC，则该字段必填。
description.en:
The ID of the VPC to which the data source belongs. >
If Type is set to VPC, this parameter is required.

descriptions.zh:
>
使用该接口需将 OceanBase 数据传输服务器的 IP 地址（请至 OMS 数据源添加页面查询） 加入到您的阿里云数据库实例的白名单、ECS 的安全规则或自建数据库对应的安全设置（通常为您自建数据库的防火墙）中以确保 OceanBase 数据传输服务可成功访问到您的数据库实例。>
descriptions.en: To call this operation, you must add the IP address of the OceanBase Migration Service (OMS) server to the whitelist of the Alibaba Cloud database instance, the security rules of the ECS instance, or the security settings of your self-managed database (usually the firewall of your self-managed database) to ensure that OMS can successfully access your database instance. To obtain the IP address of the OMS server, go to the OMS data source management page in the OMS console.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro create-oms-mysql-data-source --name oms-mysql --type INTERNET --vpc-id vpc-12345abcde0000000 --instance-id pc-12ab34cd56000000 --dg-database-id dg-yhss6sdlaff0000 --ip 10.0.0000 --port 3306 --schema test --username omsTestUser --password YWJjZDEyM0Ah --description 'OMS_测试_MySQL_数据源' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro CreateOmsMysqlDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --Type INTERNET --Description 'OMS_测试_MySQL_数据源' --VpcId 'vpc-12345abcde0000000' --InstanceId 'pc-12ab34cd56000000' --Username omsTestUser --Ip '10.0.0000' --Port 3306 --Schema test --DgDatabaseId 'dg-yhss6sdlaff0000' --Name 'oms-mysql' --Password YWJjZDEyM0Ah
